# Version 4.153.1
> **RAW decoding retired** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.301/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.1 removes built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

## Breaking Changes

- **Built-in RAW and DNG decoding removed** — RAW/DNG development and extraction of embedded JPEG previews are no longer supported. Use a separate RAW decoder or convert files before loading them. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains its value of 10 for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5187](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5187))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.301

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
